note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do lowercases every column and renames P04A10A1..A7, P04A10B to u_p04a10a1..u_p04a10a7, u_p04a10b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 103-110) labels each column, 8/8, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed question numbers (P04A10A rows 1-7; P04A10B). Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.5 (checked against the rendered page image at 250 dpi), not the dictionary labels: A1-A7 dictionary labels are character-identical to the questionnaire (7/7); the P04A10B dictionary label is an abbreviated, truncated rewording ('En una escala de 1 a 10, ¿qué tan satisfecho(a) ... o ambulancias', no closing text) and was not shipped - the full printed stem was. Structure: the P04A10 left-hand framing 'Con relación al servicio municipal de emergencias' (no final punctuation, as printed) applies to the whole block -> instructions; the P04A10A lead-in 'Durante el 2024, usted considera que el servicio municipal de emergencias (Cuerpo de Bomberos y paramédicos municipales o ambulancias de la municipalidad):' is shared by A1-A7 -> section_prompt of section _1; P04A10B is its own section _2 with no prompt. Unlike drainage there is no screener question in this block, so there is no skip pattern. Interviewer lines 'Lea las opciones.' / 'Espere la respuesta.' not shipped. Options as printed: A1-A7 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 'NS' (don't know) is kept as a response category on A1-A7 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P04A10B prints bare 1-10 bubbles (dictionary value labels = own number); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' is set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 31/31 valid item x resp cells equal (a1 1/2/3 = 4169/2385/332; a2 4207/1907/772; a3 3610/2064/1212; a4 4714/1188/984; a5 4578/1190/1118; a6 2999/2689/1198; a7 215/6065/606; b 1..10 = 426/130/156/151/556/289/449/1029/727/2031) and the 942 NULL cells on b equal the source's code-98 count (942); a1-a7 have no NULLs. Live: 55,088 rows (= 8 x 6,886), 6,886 ids (= all Hogares rows), 55,088 distinct id-item, 942 NULL resp (1.7%).
